raw_segments.text: O unexpected stroke, worse than of death, must I thus leave thee paradise, thus leave
thee native soil, these happy walks and shades fit haunt of gods, where I had hoped to spend,
quiet though sad, the respite of that day that must be mortal to us both.
O flowers that never will in other climate grow, my early visitation and my last at even,
which I bred up with tender hand from the first opening bud, and gave ye names, who
now shall rear ye to the sun, or rank your tribes, and water from the ambrosial fount.
